title: Simplify futility-pruning mate guards
rationale: Stockfish PR #7135 removes !is_loss(beta) and !is_win(eval) from the child-node futility-pruning condition. The upstream PR reports passing non-regression STC (51,520 games) and LTC (140,778 games). FayE's current search.cpp still contains exactly these guards, so this is a small, isolated search change distinct from FAYE-0005.
promotion_rule: Do not merge from this 400-game screen. If the result is not clearly adverse, run a larger fresh Fishtest-style confirmation; if flat/adverse, mark no-promotion and move to another mechanism.
notes: No NNUE architecture, relational feature, time-management, or TT changes.
Because the change is functional and can alter the search tree, bench node equality and raw NPS are not used as a promotion criterion.
